newsitem.title: USA: Harvest Partners buys remote control supplier.
newsitem.headline: Harvest Partners buys remote control supplier.

text.p: Private investment firm Harvest Partners Inc said it has bought U.S. Electronics in a $78.5 million transaction that will help create the nation's second largest distributor of cable television equipment and supplies.
Harvest said it will combine U.S. Electronics with its recently-purchased TVC and form a new company called Communication Dynamics Inc.
U.S. Electronics is a supplier of replacement remote controls to operators of cable television systems.
The investment group said it will use the combined company as a platform for more acquisitions in the communications equipment supply business.
